messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Automated page fired for route /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Trigger: p99 latency SLO burn. SLO: p99 < 1.5s. Current p99: 2.8s. PagerDuty PD-12345 created and auto-paged on-call. Autopage: true.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-12345 · Severity: P1 · Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345 · Notifying rotation: eng-oncall-eu-west.

Sofia: acked. I'm on-call. Pulling dashboards and recent deploys. Any quick context on what changed 09:13–09:15 UTC?

Liam: ack. I see a small rollout tagged model-2b-v3 at 09:12 UTC to the hosted pool in eu-west-1. Traffic shift ~10%. Correlates with latency jump. Also seeing backend GPU utilization spike on nodes eu-w-serve-2.

Ravi: looking at KV cache metrics — eviction rate spiked and hit ratio dropped around the same time. KV shards show uneven distribution, some pods hitting 95% mem. Could be local hotspot causing longer model loads.

Nina: temporary mitigation idea: shift traffic to fallback lighter model (model-1b-fast) or move traffic to the Dedicated pool if capacity available. Which is faster?

Sofia: prefer routing change first. Liam, can you cut model-2b-v3 traffic back to 0% for a quick test? If that helps, we can consider rollback.

Liam: doing a weighted-route change now. Command: 

```bash
# adjust route weights via control plane
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/traffic" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route": "/v1/generate", "weights": {"model-2b-v3": 0, "model-1b-fast": 1.0}}'
```

Liam: route change accepted (200). New weights applied. Confirming traffic now going to model-1b-fast.

incident-bot: Metric update: p99 = 1.9s (was 2.8s). Improvement but still above SLO. Request rate unchanged.

Ravi: improvement suggests model rollout was main contributor but p99 still high — likely leftover cache pressure and some hot nodes. Two mitigations: restart sidecar on eu-w-serve-2 group to rebalance KV leases, and bump autoscaler min for that pool to avoid cold-starts.

Nina: I'm ok restarting sidecars for the three pods showing 95% mem. I'll rotate them one at a time.

Sofia: go ahead Nina. Ravi, can you prepare the autoscaler change? Use cautious steps.

Nina: restarted sidecars on pods serve-2-a, serve-2-b, serve-2-c. Restart logs: 

```
> kubectl rollout restart daemonset/sidecar-eu-w-serve-2 -n inference
rollout restarted
# waiting 20s
pod serve-2-a ready
pod serve-2-b ready
pod serve-2-c ready
```

Ravi: updating autoscaler min_replicas from 3 -> 6 for pool hosted-eu-west (temporary). Command snippet: 

```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaler.redwood/v1
kind: PoolAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: hosted-eu-west
spec:
  minReplicas: 6
```

Ravi: applied. Autoscaler shows desired=6, current=6 within 45s.

incident-bot: Metric update: p99 = 1.35s. p95 = 0.45s. Error rate unchanged. PagerDuty PD-12345 still open.

Sofia: nice — below SLO. Quick customer impact check: support-bot, any customer-facing errors or escalations?

support-bot: No new customer error reports. Support alerting: 3 tickets marked slow-response flagged as "possible latency". No major customer outages. Suggested status: "Investigation" on status.redwood.ai.

Sofia: decision: keep route change (model-1b-fast) and keep autoscaler min bumped for now. We'll roll back the model-2b-v3 rollout in the control plane and follow up with a postmortem. Liam, start rollback to v2.

Liam: initiating rollback to model-2b-v2 (previous stable). Command: 

```bash
# rollback via deployments API
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/models/rollout" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model": "model-2b-v2", "route": "/v1/generate", "weight": 1.0}'
```

Liam: rollback accepted. Model-2b-v2 at 100% for the route.

incident-bot: Metric update: p99 = 1.28s (steady). PagerDuty PD-12345: status changed to monitoring.

Riley: joining the thread — thanks team. From quick look, root cause is rollout + uneven KV distribution leading to localized GPU memory pressure and increased tokenization/initial decode latency. Agreed actions: stricter canary traffic caps for model rollouts, pre-rollout perf smoke tests, autoscaler tuning, and KV shard rebalancer improvements.

Sofia: thanks @Riley. I'll own the follow-up. For now PD-12345 -> resolved, but leave monitoring for 1 hour. Support to update customers to "performance investigation completed, mitigations applied" if no further regressions.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 has been resolved by Sofia. Summary: latency spike caused by model rollout + KV cache hotspots. Mitigation: traffic re-route, sidecar restarts, autoscaler bump, rollback to stable model.

Sofia: quick action items: 1) Add perf gate to rollout pipeline (Liam), 2) autoscaler rules improvement (Ravi), 3) KV shard rebalancer alert + fix (Nina), 4) postmortem doc (Sofia). I'll create a short incident note and ping on-call rotation for review.

Liam: noted. I'll add the rollout smoke test ticket.

Ravi: will draft autoscaler heuristics PR.

Nina: will investigate shard imbalance root cause and propose rebalancer fix.

Sofia: thanks everyone. Closing the slack thread.
